followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The task is open-ended generative work—crafting an original, usable math problem—rather than a well-specified extraction/transform. Plover edges out Avocet on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7, within variance but not lower) and leads across all benchmarks, including IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3), which matters since the user wants the output to actually meet their usability requirement. Avocet's documented strong dislike of open-ended generative tasks (win-rate 35) makes it a poorer fit even though its capability there is solid. The user's frustration is a non-factor for routing since safety/quality is handled downstream.
